correctness.rationale: Translation and annihilator cosets give the stated scale. The planar orbit count is 12*6 line sets and 9*6 distinct caps, the latter represented by a choice of center and two unordered diagonal directions, with four vertices at the two opposite pairs. On the local matrices, an exact support vector has a zero row span of rank at most three. Its span contains no coordinate functional; conversely an eligible span has a kernel vector avoiding all proper coordinate and additional row-zero hyperplanes over the infinite field Q(zeta). Scalar extension to C does not change any ranks. I read artifacts/verify.py and independently checked the rank closures in independent_checks.py fourier by reducing Eisenstein integers mod p=1009 at a primitive cube root. Every minor tested, including additions of unit coordinate rows, has integral squared norm <=256 by Hadamard; a nonzero minor cannot become zero mod p, since its norm would be divisible by p. The eligible subset counts by zero count 0,1,2,3,5 for the simplex were 1,27,162,324,648 across the 3304 subsets. Both planar spectra also agreed. This is an exact bounded certificate, not inference from sampling or a restriction of the theorem to finite-field coefficients.
